hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, sys, subprocess, os
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = data.get('command', '')
if 'git commit' in cmd:
    print('>>> 提交前 lint 检查...')
    result = subprocess.run(['npm', 'run', 'lint'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=os.getcwd())
    if result.returncode != 0:
        print('>>> Lint 检查失败，请修复后再提交:')
        print(result.stdout)
        print(result.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    else:
        print('>>> Lint 检查通过!')
"
